steps.name: Raise purchase requisition
steps.description: DUMMY. Requester submits a requisition that proceeds straight to purchase order issue with no approval of any kind.

steps.name: Auto-issue purchase order
steps.description: DUMMY. System issues the purchase order directly from the unapproved requisition.

steps.name: Match and post supplier invoice
steps.description: DUMMY. Accounts payable system matches the supplier invoice against the purchase order and goods receipt note, then posts the payable.

disposition_mapping.rationale: DUMMY. Requisition entry is retained but simplified, with the budget fields dropped.
DUMMY. Approval is removed outright to shorten cycle time. This is the deliberate defect in this fixture: it leaves purchase orders unsupported by an approved requisition and must fail DUMMY-R-01.
DUMMY. Manual purchase order conversion is subsumed into the system's automatic issue in TS-02.
DUMMY. The three-way match is carried over unchanged in TS-03.
